title: Lemon & pea poha
description: Light, fluffy rice flakes with peanuts and a bright squeeze of lemon.
steps: Rinse poha briefly in a sieve. Drain and rest for 5 minutes; the flakes should soften without becoming mushy.
Warm oil in a wide pan. Add mustard seeds, cover briefly as they pop, then add peanuts and toast for 2 minutes.
Finely chop the onion. Add it to the pan and cook for 4 minutes. Add peas, turmeric, salt and 2 tablespoons water; cover for 3 minutes.
Fold in the poha gently. Cover on low heat for 3 minutes. Turn off the heat and squeeze over the lemon.

title: Besan chilla
description: Savoury chickpea pancakes with crisp edges and a soft centre.
steps: Mix chickpea flour, cumin, turmeric and salt. Whisk in 160 ml water gradually to make a pourable batter.
Finely chop onion and tomato, then stir them into the batter. Rest for 5 minutes.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat and brush with a little oil. Pour in a quarter of the batter and spread gently.
Cook for 2–3 minutes until the base sets. Flip and cook for 2 minutes. Repeat with the remaining batter.

title: Vegetable upma
description: Toasted semolina, tender vegetables and warming spices.
steps: Dry-toast semolina in a pan on medium-low heat for 4 minutes, stirring constantly. Transfer to a bowl.
Heat oil, add mustard seeds and let them pop. Add chopped onion and cook for 3 minutes.
Add finely diced carrot, peas and salt. Pour in 350 ml water and bring to a simmer; cook for 5 minutes.
Lower the heat. Add semolina in a thin stream while stirring to avoid lumps. Cover for 3 minutes, fluff, and finish with lemon.

title: Everyday dal tadka
description: A comforting bowl of red lentils finished with cumin and garlic.
steps: Rinse lentils. Put in a saucepan with 650 ml water and turmeric. Bring to a boil, skim foam, then simmer partially covered for 20 minutes until soft.
Meanwhile, heat oil in a small pan. Add cumin, then chopped onion; cook for 6 minutes.
Add minced garlic and chopped tomato. Cook for 5 minutes until the tomato breaks down.
Stir the spice mixture into the lentils with salt. Simmer for 3 minutes, adding water if needed for a spoonable consistency.

title: Quick chana masala
description: Chickpeas in a thick tomato gravy, ready for rice or flatbread.
steps: Heat oil in a saucepan. Add cumin and chopped onion; cook for 6 minutes.
Stir in minced ginger and garlic for 1 minute. Add chopped tomatoes and salt; cook for 8 minutes, stirring.
Drain and rinse the cooked chickpeas. Add them with 150 ml water and garam masala.
Simmer for 10 minutes. Mash a few chickpeas against the side of the pan to thicken the gravy.

title: Paneer pepper skillet
description: Golden paneer and colourful peppers in a simple spiced tomato sauce.
steps: Cut paneer into cubes and pepper and onion into bite-sized pieces. Chop tomatoes separately.
Heat half the oil in a skillet. Brown paneer for 3 minutes, turning gently, and remove.
Add remaining oil, cumin, onion and pepper. Stir-fry for 5 minutes. Add tomato, salt and garam masala.
Cook for 7 minutes until saucy. Return paneer, add 3 tablespoons water and simmer for 3 minutes.

title: Aloo gobi
description: A dry potato and cauliflower sabzi with warm, earthy spices.
steps: Peel potatoes and cut into 2 cm cubes. Cut cauliflower into small florets and rinse.
Heat oil in a large pan. Add cumin, then potatoes. Cook, stirring, for 5 minutes.
Add cauliflower, chopped tomato, turmeric, coriander, salt and 80 ml water. Stir and cover.
Cook on medium-low for 18–22 minutes, stirring occasionally and adding a splash of water if needed. Both vegetables should be fork-tender. Uncover for 2 minutes to dry the sauce.

title: One-pot vegetable pulao
description: Fragrant basmati rice and vegetables, all in one pot.
steps: Rinse rice several times and drain. Slice onion and finely dice carrot.
Heat oil in a saucepan with a tight lid. Add cumin and onion; cook for 5 minutes.
Add carrot, peas and rice. Stir for 1 minute, then add 300 ml water and salt. Bring to a boil.
Cover and cook on the lowest heat for 12 minutes. Turn off the heat and rest, covered, for 8 minutes. Fluff with a fork.

title: Gentle moong khichdi
description: Soft rice and split mung lentils for a quiet, comforting dinner.
steps: Rinse rice and split mung lentils well. Finely dice the carrot.
Heat ghee in a saucepan. Add cumin, then carrot and turmeric; stir for 1 minute.
Add rice, lentils, salt and 800 ml water. Bring to a boil, then cover loosely and simmer for 25–30 minutes.
Stir occasionally and add hot water if it gets too thick. Finish when the lentils and rice are very soft.

title: Masala egg bhurji
description: Soft scrambled eggs with onion, tomato and a little spice.
steps: Finely chop the onion and tomato. Beat eggs in a bowl with the salt.
Heat oil over medium heat. Cook onion for 4 minutes, then add tomato and spices for 3 minutes.
Reduce heat to medium-low and add eggs. Stir gently, scraping the bottom, for 3–4 minutes until the eggs are fully set.
Serve immediately with toast or roti if you have it.

title: Cucumber mint raita
description: A cool, crunchy yogurt side for warm, spiced meals.
steps: Wash cucumber and mint. Dice cucumber small and finely chop mint.
Whisk yogurt until smooth. Fold in cucumber, mint, cumin and salt.
Serve immediately or keep covered in the refrigerator until serving.

title: Homestyle chicken curry
description: A simple, deeply flavoured chicken curry with a tomato-onion base.
steps: Chop onion, tomatoes, ginger and garlic. Cut chicken into 3 cm pieces on a separate board; wash hands and utensils after handling raw chicken.
Heat oil and cook onion for 7 minutes. Add ginger and garlic for 1 minute, then tomato, spices and salt for 7 minutes.
Add chicken and stir for 4 minutes. Add 180 ml water, cover and simmer gently for 15–20 minutes.
Check the largest chicken piece reaches 74°C at its centre with a food thermometer. Simmer uncovered to thicken the sauce if needed.

title: Tomato basil pasta
description: A bright, garlicky tomato sauce that clings to every forkful.
steps: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Cook pasta according to the pack instructions until just tender. Reserve 100 ml cooking water before draining.
Meanwhile, slice garlic. Heat olive oil in a skillet and gently cook garlic for 1 minute without browning.
Add canned tomato and salt. Simmer for 12 minutes, breaking up larger pieces with a spoon.
Toss drained pasta with the sauce, torn basil and a little reserved water until glossy.

title: Banana overnight oats
description: A make-ahead breakfast with banana, oats and creamy yogurt. Chill overnight.
steps: Mix oats, milk, yogurt and chia seeds in a covered container.
Refrigerate for at least 6 hours or overnight; the listed time is active preparation time.
Stir, divide into two bowls and top with sliced banana just before eating. Keep chilled and enjoy within 2 days.

title: Vegetable fried rice
description: A quick wok-style dinner using safely chilled cooked rice.
steps: Use cooked rice that was cooled promptly and refrigerated. Dice carrot finely; slice spring onions and garlic.
Heat oil in a large skillet. Add carrot and cook for 4 minutes. Add peas and garlic for 2 minutes.
Add rice and soy sauce. Stir-fry for 5–6 minutes, breaking up clumps, until steaming hot throughout.
Fold in spring onions and serve immediately. Reheat rice only once.

title: Smoky shakshuka
description: Eggs gently cooked in a rich tomato and pepper sauce.
steps: Dice onion and pepper. Heat oil in a wide skillet with a lid and cook both for 7 minutes.
Add paprika, cumin, tomatoes and salt. Simmer for 10 minutes until thick.
Make four hollows in the sauce and crack an egg into each. Cover and simmer gently for 6–9 minutes.
Cook until both whites and yolks are set. Serve hot, spooning sauce around the eggs.

title: Chickpea crunch salad
description: Fresh cucumber, juicy tomato and chickpeas with lemon dressing.
steps: Drain and rinse cooked chickpeas. Wash and dice cucumber and tomatoes. Finely chop onion.
Whisk lemon juice, olive oil and salt in a bowl.
Add chickpeas and vegetables and toss well. Let stand for 5 minutes for the flavours to mingle. Keep chilled until serving.

title: Bean & cheese quesadillas
description: Golden folded tortillas packed with beans and melted cheese.
steps: Drain and rinse cooked kidney beans. Mash lightly with cumin and finely chopped tomato. Grate the cheese.
Spread bean mixture over half of each tortilla. Add cheese and fold the empty half over.
Heat a little oil in a skillet over medium-low heat. Cook each folded tortilla for 2–3 minutes per side until golden and hot inside.
Cut into wedges and serve.

title: Roasted-style tomato soup
description: A velvety tomato soup made entirely on the stovetop.
steps: Dice onion and carrot and mince garlic. Heat oil in a saucepan and cook onion and carrot for 7 minutes.
Add garlic for 1 minute, followed by tomatoes and stock. Simmer for 18 minutes until carrot is soft.
Take off the heat. Blend carefully with an immersion blender, keeping the head submerged to avoid splashes.
Return to low heat briefly. Taste before adding salt, since stock varies in saltiness.

title: Peanut sesame noodles
description: Silky noodles in a savoury peanut sauce with crunchy cucumber.
steps: Cook noodles according to package directions, reserving 100 ml cooking water before draining.
Whisk peanut butter, soy sauce and lemon juice with 3 tablespoons warm cooking water until smooth.
Cut cucumber into thin strips. Toss noodles with sauce, adding more water a spoonful at a time if needed.
Top with cucumber and sesame seeds. Choose egg-free noodles for a vegan dish.

title: Garlic mushroom toast
description: Golden mushrooms on thick toast with a little creamy yogurt.
steps: Wipe mushrooms clean and slice. Mince garlic.
Heat butter in a skillet and cook mushrooms over medium-high heat for 6–8 minutes until their liquid evaporates and edges brown.
Add garlic and salt for the final minute. Toast the bread.
Spread yogurt over the toast, then top with mushrooms and serve straight away.

title: Lemon vegetable couscous
description: Fluffy couscous with chickpeas and a crisp, fresh vegetable mix.
steps: Put couscous in a heatproof bowl. Add 180 ml boiling water and half the salt; cover for 5 minutes or follow your package ratio.
Fluff with a fork. Drain chickpeas and dice cucumber and tomato.
Whisk lemon juice with olive oil and remaining salt. Toss through couscous with vegetables and chickpeas.

title: Herby potato & bean tray
description: Crisp-edged potatoes and green beans from one oven tray.
steps: Heat oven to 220°C conventional or 200°C fan. Cut potatoes into 2 cm chunks and pat dry.
Toss potatoes with oil, oregano and salt on a baking tray. Spread in one layer and roast for 25 minutes.
Trim beans and slice garlic. Add to the tray, turn potatoes and roast for another 12–15 minutes.
Check potatoes are tender inside and beans cooked through. Serve hot.

title: Lemon chicken rice bowl
description: Pan-seared chicken, fluffy rice and fresh cucumber in one bowl.
steps: Rinse rice and cook according to its package instructions. Wash cucumber and slice on a clean board.
Cut chicken into 2 cm pieces on a separate board. Toss with half the lemon juice, oil, oregano and salt. Clean hands and tools after touching raw chicken.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat. Cook chicken for 8–12 minutes, turning, until the centre of the largest piece reaches 74°C on a food thermometer.
Divide rice, chicken and cucumber between bowls. Finish with the remaining lemon juice.
